zh-CN.title: 龟兹
zh-CN.subtitle: 丝绸之路上的语言、音乐与佛教交流节点
zh-CN.shortSummary: 龟兹使求法路线不再只是从长安指向印度的直线，而成为多语言、多宗教和多种媒介交错的区域。
curatorialDescription: 本条使用现实地理层描述区域节点；具体佛寺、石窟、人物与艺术对象需要另建条目。
“龟兹”是历史名称，现代地理对应和历史范围不能用一个点位完全替代。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充历史地名对应、考古报告、石窟和语言文化资料的具体定位。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 隋唐交通与佛教交流语境

en.title: Kucha
en.subtitle: A Silk Road node of language, music and Buddhist exchange
en.shortSummary: Kucha keeps a pilgrimage route from becoming a straight line from Chang'an to India; it was a region where languages, religions and media intersected.
curatorialDescription: This record uses the real-geography layer for a regional node; specific monasteries, caves, figures and objects require separate records.
Kucha is a historical name whose modern referent and historical extent cannot be reduced to one point.
en.researchNote: Historical place-name mapping, archaeological reports, cave sites and linguistic-cultural sources still need precise locators.
en.timeLabel: Sui–Tang transport and Buddhist exchange context
